"
};
const sound={
  enabled:false,current:null,desired:'corona',tracks:{},fadeFrame:null,
  volume:0.53,fx:null,fxCtx:null,visibilityPaused:false,
  mood(){
    if(view==='home'||view==='naming')return 'corona';if(view==='doom')return state?.doomKind==='dragon'?'dragon':'amenaza';
    if(view==='end')return 'legado';if(view==='explore'){return exploreSite==='hermandad'?'hermandad':exploreSite==='mandibula'?'amenaza':exploreSite==='diafragma'?'alianza':'cripta';}
    if(view==='game'&&state){if(state.scene.startsWith('dr20_'))return 'dragon';
      if(state.scene==='bridge_e'||(state.scene.startsWith('e')&&state.scene!=='ending')){if(['e01','e07','e08','e19'].includes(state.scene))return 'dragon';if(['e17','e22','e23h'].includes(state.scene))return 'hermandad';if(['e24','e25'].includes(state.scene))return 'legado';return 'reconquista';}if(state.scene==='y21'||state.scene==='y25')return 'dragon';
      if(state.scene==='bridge_y'||/^y\d+x?$/.test(state.scene))return 'reconquista';
      if(['x18'].includes(state.scene))return 'dragon';
      if(state.scene==='bridge_x'||/^x\d+[hm]?$/.test(state.scene))return 'hermandad';
      if(state.scene==='bridge_w'||state.scene==='z6'||state.scene==='z7'||state.scene==='z8'||state.scene==='z9'||state.scene==='z10'||['w7','w8','w8x','w9','w10'].includes(state.scene))return 'dragon';
      if(state.scene==='bridge_z'||state.scene.startsWith('z')||state.scene.startsWith('w'))return 'amenaza';
      if(['bridge_q','bridge_h','bridge_d','bridge_m','bridge_r','bridge_a','bridge_f','bridge_t','a8','a10','f11','t10','q11','h10','d10','m10'].includes(state.scene))return 'alianza';
      if(['p4','p5','c6','c10','q4','q5','q9','h7','h8','h11','d3','d7','d9','m2','m8','m9','r2','a3','a9','f1','f3','f5','f7','f9','t4','t5','t8','t9'].includes(state.scene))return 'amenaza';
      if(state.alarm>=3&&['c7','c8','c9','c11','q7','q8','q10','h9','d6','d8','m3','m7','r1','a2','a4','a7','f4','f6','f6x','f8','t2','t3','t6','t7'].includes(state.scene))return 'amenaza';
    }
    return 'cripta';
  },
  track(id){
    if(!this.tracks[id]){
      const el=new Audio('data:audio/mpeg;base64,'+MUSICA_ORIGINAL[id]);
      el.loop=true;el.preload='auto';el.volume=0;el.playsInline=true;
      el.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
      this.tracks[id]=el;
    }
    return this.tracks[id];
  },
  sync(){
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-action="sound"]').forEach(b=>{
      b.textContent=this.enabled?'♫ Música ON':'♪ Música OFF';
      b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(this.enabled));
      b.setAttribute('title',this.enabled?'Silenciar banda sonora épica original':'Activar banda sonora épica original');
    });
  },
  async toggle(){
    if(this.enabled){this.stop();this.sync();toast('Banda sonora en silencio.');return;}
    this.enabled=true;
    const good=this.change(this.mood(),true);
    this.sync();
    if(good){toast('Banda sonora épica activada. ♫');}
  },
  change(id,force=false){
    this.desired=id;
    if(!this.enabled)return false;
    if(id===this.current&&!force)return true;
    const previous=this.current;
    this.current=id;
    const next=this.track(id);
    if(force||next.paused){try{next.currentTime=0;}catch(e){}}
    try{
      const attempt=next.play();
      if(attempt&&typeof attempt.catch==='function')attempt.catch(()=>{
        if(this.current!==id||!this.enabled)return;
        this.stop();this.sync();toast('Tu navegador ha bloqueado la música. Pulsa «Música OFF» para intentarlo otra vez.');
      });
    }catch(err){this.stop();this.sync();toast('No se pudo activar la música en este navegador.');return false;}
    if(this.fadeFrame!==null)cancelAnimationFrame(this.fadeFrame);
    const from={};for(const [k,el] of Object.entries(this.tracks))from[k]=el.volume;
    const started=performance.now(),duration=previous?1750:1450;
    const fade=(now)=>{
      if(!this.enabled)return;
      const x=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(now-started)/duration));
      const smooth=x*x*(3-2*x);
      for(const [k,el] of Object.entries(this.tracks)){
        el.volume=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(from[k]||0)*(1-smooth)+(k===id?this.volume*smooth:0)));
      }
      if(x<1)this.fadeFrame=requestAnimationFrame(fade);
      else{
        this.fadeFrame=null;
        for(const [k,el] of Object.entries(this.tracks))if(k!==id){el.pause();try{el.currentTime=0}catch(e){}}
      }
    };
    this.fadeFrame=requestAnimationFrame(fade);
    return true;
  },
  stop(){
    this.enabled=false;this.current=null;
    if(this.fadeFrame!==null)cancelAnimationFrame(this.fadeFrame);
    this.fadeFrame=null;
    for(const a of Object.values(this.tracks)){
      a.pause();a.volume=0;try{a.currentTime=0}catch(e){}
    }
  },
  tick(hz){
    // Subtle original UI effect, separate from the music. The game still works without audio.
    if(!this.enabled)return;
    try{
      const AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;
      if(!AC)return;
      if(!this.fxCtx)this.fxCtx=new AC();
      if(this.fxCtx.state==='suspended')this.fxCtx.resume();
      const ctx=this.fxCtx,t=ctx.currentTime,o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain();
      o.type='sine';o.frequency.setValueAtTime(hz,t);
      o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(80,hz*.73),t+.16);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(.029,t);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+.18);
      o.connect(g);g.connect(ctx.destination);o.start(t);o.stop(t+.185);
    }catch(e){}
  },
  onVisibility(){
    if(!this.enabled)return;
    if(document.hidden){
      this.visibilityPaused=true;
      for(const el of Object.values(this.tracks))el.pause();
      if(this.fxCtx)this.fxCtx.suspend();
    }else if(this.visibilityPaused){
      this.visibilityPaused=false;
      const target=this.tracks[this.current];
      if(target){const attempt=target.play();if(attempt&&attempt.catch)attempt.catch(()=>{this.stop();this.sync()});}
    }
  }
};
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>sound.onVisibility());
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(view!=='game'||modalOpen||e.altKey||e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey||e.repeat||!/^\d$/.test(e.key)||e.key==='0'||e.target.closest('input,textarea,select'))return;const i=Number(e.key)-1;const opts=current().choices;if(opts[i]&&(!opts[i].required||opts[i].required(state))){e.preventDefault();choose(i)}});
try{const v=Number(localStorage.getItem('casas_reino_vol_v1'));if(v>=0&&v<=100&&localStorage.getItem('casas_reino_vol_v1')!==null)sound.volume=v/100}catch(e){}
render();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
